summary: An O3DE gem for spawning and managing thousands of queryable dynamic objects (collectibles, debris, ambient FX, NPC spawns) without per-entity overhead. It manages both persistent items that remain in the world until picked up, as well as timed transient objects, using a Structure-of-Arrays (SoA) SlotTable for hot data. It includes a budgeted asynchronous SpawnExecutor for entity creation, and a pluggable, deterministic procedural provider system with Lua exposure. The architecture is built to support future seed-based multiplayer replication.
